subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom.

Prakash could not __make up his mind__ about what to do with the project.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"make up one's mind"** means to decide what to do or choose a course of action. (निर्णय लेना)

 
 
• **Example: **She couldn't **make up her mind** whether to accept the job offer or not.
 
 
 
• **"Decide" **refers to making a choice or coming to a conclusion about something. (निर्णय करना)
 
 
• **Example: **He **decided** to go on a vacation after a long year of hard work.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that **"make up his mind"** means to** "decide".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Think **(सोचना): To consider or reflect on something.

 
 
• **Example:** She needs time to** think** about the proposal.
 
 
 
• **Abandon **(त्यागना): To leave something or someone completely.
 
 
• **Example: **They had to **abandon **the sinking ship.
 
 
 
• **Abide** (पालन करना): To accept or act in accordance with a rule, decision, or recommendation.
 
 
• **Example:** We must **abide **by the rules of the game.
 
 

41:Tbfb,

The correct answer is **Option 1)**
